wiki.title: Sean Garballey
wiki.extract: Sean Garballey (born February 22, 1985) is an American politician, the current Massachusetts State Representative for the 23rd Middlesex District representing Arlington and West Medford. He was elected in a special election on 4 March 2008, after the incumbent, J. James Marzilli Jr. won a 2007 special election for a seat in the Massachusetts Senate.
